text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisia to reinforce financial and technical cooperation with the European Union.
- Exports rose by 14.7 percent during the first six months of 1997 compared to one percent during the same period of last year.

- Cooperation and Foreign Investment Minister Mohamed Ghannouchi discussed ways to boost trade and financial cooperation with visiting Chinese assistant Minister of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation Sun Guangxiang.
- "King" of soul music James Brown arrived on Wednesday in Tunis to take part in the festival of Carthage on July 20.
- Some 41 million dinars devoted to road substructure in southern region of Sfax.
